readingHtml:
The Future of Travel

Future Tenses and Modals

A.Next summer, Araylim is going to travel to London. She is flying there on July 15th. She is very excited because it is a great opportunity. Her flight leaves at 9 AM. While she is there, she will be exploring many museums.

B.Her parents gave her some advice. "You must not leave your luggage alone," her mother said. "You should always keep your passport safe." Araylim has to remember to check in online. She is allowed to take one small bag onto the plane.

C.By the time she returns, she will have visited at least five famous places. She hopes she will manage to speak English every day. She wants to avoid speaking Russian to practice more.
